tooltip.godtechascension.god_pickaxe: Unbreakable & Lava-Proof. 10x Efficiency V speed, 3x3 mining (Sneak for 1x1).
tooltip.godtechascension.god_sword: Unbreakable & Lava-Proof. 25 Attack Damage + Right-Click 5-Block AoE Slash.
tooltip.godtechascension.plasma_railgun: Right-Click: Fires a piercing 30-block Plasma Beam (28 Damage).
tooltip.godtechascension.quantum_magnet_: Pulls nearby item drops within 8 blocks (hold Sneak to pause).
tooltip.godtechascension.quantum_warp_li: Right-Click a Quantum Warp Beacon to bind, then Right-Click to teleport.
tooltip.godtechascension.ascension_helme: Unbreakable & Lava-Proof. Grants Night Vision + Water Breathing.
tooltip.godtechascension.ascension_jetpa: Unbreakable & Lava-Proof. Powered by Blaze Powder; includes km/h & km Odometer HUD.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_ore: Generates underground between Y = -64 and Y = 32. Mine with an Iron Pickaxe or better to obtain Raw Titanium (affected by Fortune).
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_casin: Industrial casing block crafted from Titanium Sheets, Iron Ingots, and Redstone. Used to craft the Arc Reactor, Alloy Synthesizer, and Warp Beacon.
jei.godtechascension.info.arc_reactor: Endgame FE generator powered by a God Core. Produces 16,384 FE/t continuously (1,000,000 FE buffer) and auto-pushes power to adjacent PowerGrid wires and machines.
jei.godtechascension.info.alloy_synthesi: FE-powered 2-input sci-fi machine. Synthesizes Titanium Alloy, Quantum Circuits, and Singularity Shards.
jei.godtechascension.info.quantum_warp_b: Teleport anchor block. Right-click with a Quantum Warp Linker to bind your base or airship dock.
jei.godtechascension.info.raw_titanium: Mined from Titanium Ore. Smelt or blast into a Titanium Ingot, or combine with Flint to make Crushed Raw Titanium.
jei.godtechascension.info.crushed_raw_ti: Create-style crushed titanium intermediate. Smelt or blast into a Titanium Ingot.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_ingot: Refined from Raw Titanium or Crushed Raw Titanium. Craft into Titanium Sheets or Titanium Alloy.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_sheet: Pressed industrial plate made from Titanium Ingots. Used to craft Titanium Casing and Reinforced Mechanisms.
jei.godtechascension.info.titanium_alloy: High-strength industrial alloy. Craftable by hand or in the Alloy Synthesizer.
jei.godtechascension.info.reinforced_mec: Precision mechanical assembly crafted from Titanium Sheets, Gold, Copper, and Redstone.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_crystal: Radiant energy crystal crafted from Diamond, Amethyst Shards, Blaze Powder, and Redstone.
jei.godtechascension.info.void_shard: Condensed void material crafted from Obsidian, Ender Pearls, and Amethyst Shards.
jei.godtechascension.info.quantum_circui: Advanced circuit board used in the Arc Reactor, Alloy Synthesizer, Exosuit, Railgun, and God Core.
jei.godtechascension.info.singularity_sh: Synthesized in the Alloy Synthesizer from God Crystal + Void Shard. Used in the Plasma Railgun, Magnet Ring, and Exosuit.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_core: Endgame Ascension core crafted from God Crystals, Quantum Circuits, and a Nether Star. Lava-proof.
jei.godtechascension.info.god_pickaxe: Unbreakable, lava-proof pickaxe that mines 10x faster than Efficiency V in a 3x3 area (hold Sneak for 1x1).
jei.godtechascension.info.god_sword: Unbreakable, lava-proof 25-damage blade. Right-click to unleash a 5-block AoE Energy Slash.
jei.godtechascension.info.plasma_railgun: Fires a piercing 30-block cyan plasma beam dealing 28 damage (1.5s cooldown). Lava-proof.
jei.godtechascension.info.quantum_magnet: Pulls all dropped items within 8 blocks straight to you while in your inventory (hold Sneak to pause).
jei.godtechascension.info.quantum_warp_l: Right-click a Quantum Warp Beacon to bind, then right-click anywhere to teleport back across dimensions.
jei.godtechascension.info.ascension_helm: Unbreakable, lava-proof Exosuit Helmet. Grants Night Vision and Water Breathing.
jei.godtechascension.info.ascension_ches: Unbreakable, lava-proof Exosuit Chestplate. Grants Fire Resistance.
jei.godtechascension.info.ascension_jetp: Unbreakable, lava-proof Jetpack fueled by Blaze Powder (right-click with Blaze Powder in inventory or hand). Displays a live km/h speedometer, km odometer, and fuel gauge HUD.
jei.godtechascension.info.ascension_legg: Unbreakable, lava-proof Exosuit Leggings. Grants Speed II.
jei.godtechascension.info.ascension_boot: Unbreakable, lava-proof Exosuit Boots. Grants Fall-Damage Immunity.
